title: Fragment about a jealous girl at a dance
summary: A short unattributed fragment about a girl in an evening gown who grows jealous watching her boyfriend dance with another girl.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: That poor girl lay on the floor and died like that. She would dance with this other girl's boyfriend and they had a little misunderstanding at first time. They was just dancing and talking, you know. She had on her fine evening gown and he had on his tux. Oh, and that girl, she stood there and she looked at him. She looked at her boyfriend talking with this girl. This girl is so beautiful, you know. She looked so nice. She had a nice evening gown, shoes, everything matched. And she just walked right on over there. If it wasn't so many people on the floor, I knew she was jealous. I would have jumped off.
